title: Get to Know GetCashback.ai
description: Learn about GetCashback.ai and how it helps you maximize your cashback rewards
content: Welcome to GetCashback.aiGetCashback.ai is your AI-powered cashback copilot that helps you discover, activate, and maximize cashback offers across thousands of merchants, and leading credit cards, debit cards, and grocery loyalty programs—so you never miss a chance to earn, online or in-store.What is GetCashback.ai?GetCashback.ai is available as a browser extension, web platform, and mobile app for iOS and Android. It brings together the power of AI and automation to help you:  Discover 5,000+ cashback offers from 10+ cashback and reward programs  Auto-activate cashback and clip digital coupons, linking them directly to your card and grocer accounts so you never miss savings at checkout  Track your cashback earnings across all your programs in one dashboard  Chat with Max, your AI assistant, to find the best deals and offers effortlessly  Get smart reminders and recommendations powered by AI that understands offer terms and nudges you to use the best card at the right time  Keep full control of your data with privacy-first design, local storage by default, and optional Google Sheets export for transparency and controlKey Features🔍 Smart Offer DiscoveryOur AI scans thousands of cashback offers in real-time and matches them with your intent—whether you’re shopping online, in-store, or even just browsing.⚡ Auto-Activation & Grocery Coupon ClippingGetCashback.ai now automatically activates offers and clips digital coupons, and links them to your bank and grocer accounts, so you’re always saving without needing to remember.💬 Ask Max: Your Cashback CopilotAsk Max anything—like “Where can I save on coffee?” or “Which card gives the best cashback at Target?” Max will search and summarize the best offers instantly.📱 Mobile App (iOS & Android)Maximize cashback on the go with our mobile app. Browse, chat with Max, link and activate offers straight from your phone.💳 Multi-Program & Card SupportTrack and manage offers from your credit cards, debit cards, and grocery loyalty programs.📊 Earnings DashboardVisualize your cashback history, top merchants, and programs you’re earning from. Make smarter spending decisions with insights powered by AI.🎯 AI-Powered Recommendations & RemindersOur AI doesn’t just match—you get proactive suggestions based on your browsing or purchase intent. Whether it’s choosing the right card, stacking offers, or spotting exclusions in the fine print, Max has your back.🔒 Privacy & Data ControlYour data is stored locally by default. If you want to export your offer usage or history, you can optionally sync to a private Google Sheet—nothing is shared without your consent.Platform Feature ComparisonHere’s what you can do with GetCashback.ai across our browser extension, mobile app, and web platform:            Feature      Browser Extension      Mobile App      Web Platform                  Privacy-first design                                Offer discovery      Search, Sort & Filter      Ask Max v2      Ask Max v1              Recommendations      Value vs. Effort Ratings      Ask Max v2      Value vs. Effort Ratings              Multi-program and card support                                Automatically link offers to cards                                 Grocery coupon clipping                                 Track cashback earnings                                  Just-in-time card & offer suggestions                                  Map view of local in-store cashback opportunities                                  Export data to Google Sheets                          Getting StartedWant to start saving smarter? Here’s how to get started:  Install the browser extension or download the mobile app  Register your clients  Link offers and enable auto-activation  Chat with Max and start stacking cashbackNeed Help?Explore our FAQs or reach out through Ask Max for real-time help finding offers and getting setup.GetCashback.ai – Your AI-powered cashback copilot

title: Ask Max
description: Get instant help from Max, your AI-powered cashback assistant
content: Ask Max – Your Cashback CopilotMeet Max, your personal AI-powered assistant here to help you maximize your cashback earnings and answer any questions about GetCashback.ai.What is Ask Max?Max is an AI assistant trained specifically on cashback offers in the GetCashback.ai platform. Available 24/7, Max can help you:  Find relevant offers for your shopping  Link offers to your accounts  Recommend the best options based on your goalsHow to Access MaxOn the Website  Visit getcashback.ai  Open the chat box at the bottom of the page  Start asking Max your questionsOn the Mobile App  Install the GetCashback.ai app  Tap the chat box at the bottom of the home screen  Start your conversation with MaxWhat Max Can Do            Feature      Website (v1)      Mobile App (v2)                  Search for offers by product, service, category, merchant, or provider                          Narrow down offers to match your shopping needs                           Auto-link offers to your accounts                           Provide personalized recommendations                   Example ConversationsSearchYou: “Where can I save on coffee?”Max: “Looks like you’re interested in coffee! Here are some cashback offers that might work for you…” followed by a carousel of coffee-related offers and their sources.Shopping GuideYou: “My TV is broken.”Max: “I am sorry to hear that! What kind of TV are you looking for? Or, are you interested in a specific brand or store?”You: “OLED TV from LG, Sony or Samsung?”Max: “I didn’t find any specific cashback offers for OLED TV from LG, Sony or Samsung. Would you like to see general offers from these brands, or perhaps search for TVs from different brands”You: “Let us see general offers from those brands.”Max: “You can get cashback offers from Sony Electronics and Samsung. There are also offers available for LG Electronics and LG Partner Store. Would you like to see offers for a specific product or a different provider?” followed by a carousel of those offers.Auto-LinkYou: “Can you activate those offers?”Max: “Please tap the "log in to link offers" button on each offer. I will guide you at the top of the screen after you tap "log in to link offers" on each offer.”RecommendationsYou: “Can you recommend the best travel offers for a $1000 weekend trip?”Max: “I found several travel offers for you, including discounts on hotels with Booking.com, packages with Apple Vacations, and deals with Hotwire. There are also offers for Disneyland Resort and American Express cardholders for the Hard Rock Hotel New York. Since my results are narrowed down, would you like to see more offers or refine your search?” followed by a carousel of those offers.Privacy and SecurityWhat Max Knows  Messages you send to Max  Max’s messages to you  Active cashback offers from supported provider sourcesWhat Max Does Not Know  Who you are  Your email  Your account information  Your usernames or passwords  Your transaction history  Which offers are linked to your accountTips for Getting the Best Help      Be SpecificInstead of “Show me grocery offers” try:“Show me Safeway food offers for $20 purchases.”        Provide ContextInstead of “What’s the best offer?” try:“What’s the best offer for $500/month groceries and $300/month gas?”        Ask Follow-up QuestionsYou can request clarifications, step-by-step guides, or reasoning behind recommendations.  If Max seems confused or off-track, tap the “↻” Refresh button in the top-right corner to reset the conversation. This clears the chat history and gives you a fresh start.LimitationsMax cannot:  Make purchases or complete transactions  Access your bank, card, or loyalty accounts directly  Provide financial advice beyond cashback optimization  Guarantee specific cashback amounts or outcomesReady to start optimizing your cashback? Ask Max a question now and see how AI can boost your earnings!

title: Browser Extension
description: Learn how to install and use the GetCashback.ai browser extension
content: GetCashback.ai Browser ExtensionThe GetCashback.ai browser extension is your AI-powered cashback copilot. It automatically collects, activates, and organizes offers while helping you make smarter cashback decisions — privately, securely, and effortlessly.Supported BrowsersGetCashback.ai is available for:  Google Chrome  Microsoft Edge  Other Chromium-based browsersInstallationChrome Installation  Visit the Chrome Web Store  Click “Add to Chrome”  Confirm by clicking “Add extension”  Click the puzzle icon in your toolbar  and pin the GetCashback.ai extension  for easier access.Edge Installation  Visit the Microsoft Edge Add-ons store  Click “Get” to install  Click the puzzle icon   and pin the GetCashback.ai extension  for easier access.Register Your ExtensionAfter installation:  Click the GetCashback.ai icon  in your toolbar to open the Wallet.  You’ll be prompted to register the extension.  Review the agreement, enter your email, and click “I Agree”.  Check your inbox for an email from GetCashback.ai <support@getcashback.ai> and click “Verify Email Address” button.  You’ll receive a welcome email confirming your registration.Once registered, you’re ready to start collecting cashback offers automatically.Key Features🧠 Auto-Collect Offers as You BrowseGetCashback.ai detects and auto-activates offers when you’re logged into supported banks or grocery loyalty websites.To explore supported sites:  Open the Wallet and click “Collect” from the left menu.Need a head start?  On the “Places to Hunt for Offers” page, click “Hunt Offers” to be taken directly to the right offer pages.When you arrive on a supported page:  The Widget will appear and guide you through collecting.  You can move the Widget by hoving over the icon and click “Click here to move” button if needed.  Once the offer page fully loads, it will display the number of offers available.  Click the Widget to start collecting. You’ll see progress and can pause/resume anytime.  When done, click the extension icon to view collected offers in your Wallet.🔒 Privacy-First by DesignWe never access your bank credentials or share your data.  No card linking or login sharing  No browsing or purchase tracking  Everything runs locally in your browserPermissions Requested:  Active tab – Detect merchant and bank pages  Storage – Save preferences and offers locally  Notifications – Remind you when offers are available  Geolocation – Show in-store cashback nearby  Host permissions – Display the auto-collect Widget  Identity – (Optional) Upload offers to Google Sheets📊 Smart Offer Discovery & FilteringYour Wallet shows all collected offers with powerful tools to search, sort, and filter:  Search by brand, product, or category  Sort by expiration, value, or effort  Filter by provider, card, category, type, redeeming location, status, min spend, and max cashback.🤖 AI Offer Review and Value AnalysisMany offers have unclear terms — we use AI to make them easy to understand.  Standardized cashback, min spend, max cashback, expiration  Extract redemption links  Show Value vs. Effort Ratings  Recommend best offers based on your spend patterns🔢 Extension Icon BadgeThe badge icon has two modes:  It shows how many offers you’ve collected by default   When you’re on a site with redeemable offers, it shows the number of offers available 🔔 Real-Time RemindersThe extension will notify you while browsing when eligible offers are available — so you never miss a chance to earn.🗺️ In-Store Cashback DiscoveryYou can browse the interactive map to discover nearby in-store cashback opportunities.🛍️ Record Offer RedemptionsYou can manually log your offer redemptions right from the Wallet dashboard to keep track of your earnings.📦 Export to CSV or Google SheetsYou can export your offers to a CSV file or upload them to a private Google Sheet — great for tracking or analyzing with your own tools or AI.UpdatesThe extension updates automatically to keep your features and security up to date. You may check your version in your browser’s extension settings.Latest Version1.1.1Start maximizing your cashback — install GetCashback.ai today!

title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Find answers to common questions about GetCashback.ai, its browser extension, mobile app, and AI assistant Max.
content: Frequently Asked QuestionsFind quick answers to the most common questions about GetCashback.ai, including the browser extension, mobile app, and Ask Max AI assistant.GeneralWhat is GetCashback.ai?GetCashback.ai is an AI-powered cashback platform that helps you discover, activate, and maximize cashback offers across thousands of merchants, credit cards, debit cards, and grocery loyalty programs. title: Linking Offers
description: Learn how to activate and track cashback offers with GetCashback.ai
content: Linking OffersLearn how to properly activate cashback offers and ensure your purchases are tracked for maximum earnings.Understanding Offer LinkingWhat is Offer Linking?Offer linking is the process of activating your cashback offers to a specific debit card, credit card, or grocery store account before you check out. This ensures that your purchases are eligible for cashback rewards.Why is Linking Important?  Ensures eligibility: Purchases made without activated offers are not eligible for cashback rewards or discounts.  Maximizes earnings: You can stack linked cashback offers with other cashback programs, such as Rakuten (for online shopping through a link) and Fetch (for receipt scanning), to get a higher cashback rate.  Receive reminders: Cashback program providers usually send reminder emails before an offer expires, so you don’t miss out on any rewards.How GetCashback.ai Links OffersBrowser Extension WidgetWhen you visit a cashback offer provider, GetCashback.ai:  Displays the Widget to guide you through the process.  Automatically detects offers on the offer page.  One click to start collecting — the Widget will go through offers one by one to link all of them to the account or card.Ask Max on Mobile App  When Max finds an offer you like, tap “Log in to link offers”. You’ll be guided to log into the provider’s site within the in-app browser.  Once logged in, you can tap to detect offers on the page. If offers are available, Max will display the count.  Tap again to start collecting — Max will go through offers one by one to link all of them to the account or card.Types of Offers            Offer Type      Activation Required?      Stackable?      Auto-Linkable?                  Cashback Credit Cards(e.g. 1%–5% cashback)      Automatic when using the card                           Quarterly Bonus Categories      Must activate                           Cashback Apps(e.g. Rakuten)       Must use their link                           Bank Portals  (e.g. Chase, Amex)      Must activate the offers                          Store Digital Coupons  (e.g. Safeway)      Must clip the coupons                          Store Cards      Automatic when using the card                            Receipt Scanning App  (e.g. Fetch)                          Maximizing Your EarningsTriple Cashback Hack        View this post on Instagram            A post shared by (@)Ready to start linking offers? Install the extension or download the mobile app and start maximizing your cashback earnings today!

title: Mobile App
description: Learn about GetCashback.ai mobile apps for iOS and Android

RegisterWhen you first open the app, tap the “Register” button to get started. You’ll be asked to accept the User Agreement and enter your email address.        Verify Your EmailCheck your inbox for an email from GetCashback.ai <support@getcashback.ai>. Click the “Verify Email Address” button to complete your registration.        Start ExploringAfter verification, re-open the app and start chatting with Max to find and activate cashback offers. Tap the website icon in the top-right corner of the screen.Ready to save smarter?Download the GetCashback.ai app and start linking high-value offers with the help of Max today.
